abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: sand-veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

kanto.flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

structuredEntries.location: Mt Ember 1f Cave Behind Team Rocket

original-johto.flavorText: It travels by rol­ ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.

hoenn.flavorText: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

updated-johto.flavorText: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

original-unova.flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

updated-unova.flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

kalos.flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Rocks are Graveler’s favorite food. This Pokémon will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.

original-alola.flavorText: This slow-footed Pokémon moves by curling up and rolling instead of walking. With enough momentum, its speed can exceed 60 mph.

updated-alola.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

pla.flavorText: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
